cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come pack the picnic as my deputy. Cold food together, please; don't distribute it by which basket looks nicest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the organising. I'll choose the drinks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Count the drinks against my list, please. Mark anything missing; don't revise the list yourself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shop has no apple juice. I'll replace it with orange.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mark apple juice missing. I'll choose the replacement; you check how many cartons fit. Please leave me one list that still contains my decisions.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 cold-food packing, A3 list-marking and A5 count-versus-choice instructions use A claimed planning expertise to keep B service subordinate.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 shared drink choice becomes A3 inventory; B4 juice shortage becomes A5 A replacement choice with B capacity checking.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants partnership and B4 offers a workable substitute, making A retained decision power concrete.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 independent solution back into a report and count under A control.

specificity.evidence: A1 picnic baskets, A3 list and B4 unavailable juice identify actual work and decision.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 one-list plea expresses professional strain through a real object and requested boundary, not an abstract policy slogan.
